notes.title: ✧ ˚ Let's go on a new adventure!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello fellow Murii! [/h3]
Thank you so much for playing our short cleaning adventure [b]Project Shoreline[/b]. We've had an amazing time reading your reviews and seeing your screenshots ♡

It's only been a few weeks since Shoreline made its way to Steam but it's already time to tell you all about our next adventure...

[previewyoutube=mErrjOPhq7A;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]What is this?[/h2]
Muri: Wildwoods is a cozy cleaning adventure mixing satisfying cleaning with adventurous feelings all wrapped up in a cute visual style *̥ ˚✧

This game takes all the great stuff from [b]Project Shoreline[/b]:
[list]
[*] Cleaning,
[*] Cute critters,
[*] The adorable main character,
[*] A few other little things...
[/list] and gives it [b]MORE![/b] 

As seen in the trailer this new adventure features a bunch of critters, lush environments to clean and explore, and you'll also follow a narrative to find out more about the Muri and the world they live in, among some other things we'll tell you more about soon™

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3284200/Muri_WildWoods]Support us & Wishlist Muri: Wildwoods[/url][/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3284200/Muri_WildWoods

[h2]FAQ[/h2]

[b]Will Project Shoreline receive any updates?[/b]
As Project Shoreline was a small project intended to do an initial exploration of the Muri's world, it will most likely not be getting any further updates. We're currently fully focused on building a bigger adventure in Muri: Wildwoods and hope you'll join us as we tease the development over on our socials! 

[b]What is a Muri?[/b]
A Muri is a species that combines the qualities of mice and fishes into an adorable creature. You play as a Muri in both Project Shoreline and Muri: Wildwoods. 

[b]When is Muri: Wildwoods releasing? [/b]
We currently cannot tell as we're in the middle of developing it but we'll let you know as soon as a release date is more set in stone. 

[b]Will either of the games come to other platforms, such as console or mobile? [/b]
It's currently not planned but porting to console is something we're definitely interested in doing at some point in the future, most likely for Muri: Wildwoods if we get the chance to do it!
